executive_assessment.text: NDC names droughts, floods and heatwaves as major disasters, lists drought seasons in 2012-13, 2015-16, 2018-19 and 2023-24, and says drought exposure varies across Zimbabwe.
World Bank says agriculture employs 70 percent of Zimbabwe's population; reliance on rainfed systems and maize leaves the sector vulnerable to climate events, especially ENSO-linked droughts.
NDC reports that the National Adaptation Plan identifies 18 priority outputs across seven sectors, including agriculture, water, health, infrastructure and human settlements.
